wake.text:
Hoo... hmm... Zzzz...
ZzWAK! Oh! Oh my. A
thousand pardons — you've
caught me having a bit of a
lie-down.

wake_2.text:
I am, I confess, rather
nocturnal by disposition.
Daylight hours are a trial.
Hoo... But do come in, come
in. Welcome, all the same.

welcome.text:
Hoo! Good evening to you,
and welcome! It is a genuine
pleasure to receive a
visitor at this civilised
hour.

orient_1.text:
Since you are new here, permit
me a brief word about the
place. We are the {town}
branch of the Farway Museum
— a smaller cousin, but no
less earnest for it.

orient_2.text:
We keep four collections:
fossils, paintings, fish, and
insects. I appraise each
specimen that comes through
the door personally, hoo.

orient_3.text:
I am, alas, the entire staff.
One owl. So we rely upon the
generosity of residents to
build the collections. Might
I count on your help?

orient_stop_q.prompt:
I do go on. Shall I stop
there, or prattle further?

orient_4.text:
Splendid! By "donation" I do
not mean whatever you wish
to be rid of, mind. We are
selective. But a fine fossil
or a rare fish — those we
receive with open wings.

orient_5.text:
One specimen of each kind,
that is the rule. Bring it to
me and I shall see it
properly displayed. Now —
enough of my blathering.

orient_skip.text:
Ha! A merciful soul. Very
well — the short version is
simply this: bring me
fossils, art, fish, or bugs,
and I shall do the rest.

repeat_day.text:
Hoo... Back again? Forgive
the heavy eyelids. Do have a
wander — the wings are
through the far doors.

repeat_night.text:
Hoo hoo! Well met once more.
The collection is always here
for you. Is there anything
you need?

menu.prompt:
Now then — is there something
I can help you with?

about_empty.text:
In all honesty? At present we
have a large, costly, and
thoroughly empty building.
But we are open at all hours,
and every donation helps.

about_progress.text:
The collection comes along
nicely, hoo. There is much
worth seeing already — and
many a gap still waiting to
be filled.

about_complete.text:
Every display is full, every
collection complete. A museum
to rival any in the world, and
it was built entirely by the
hands of this town. Glorious!

farewell.text:
Of course. Take your time,
and enjoy your visit. Hoo!
